source.method: Distance from either printed source endpoint to 2021 class-40 cropland pixels; exact raster-derived polygon boundaries in UTM 51N. Display polygons simplified by 12 m. No-data cells remain unknown. Search tested within 1 km of both endpoints.
source.limits: Class 40 describes annual herbaceous cropland; woody perennial crops may be tree/shrub cover. This dated satellite classification does not establish present farms, property boundaries, ownership, access or wrongdoing. Review includes intermediate distance combinations so all projects remain counted.
